import cv2
import numpy as np

def ray_ground(u, v, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    z_c = 1.55 / ((v - 256) / 256)
    x_c = (u - 256) / 256 * z_c
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    wx = cam_x + z_c * np.sin(theta) + x_c * np.cos(theta)
    wy = cam_y + z_c * np.cos(theta) - x_c * np.sin(theta)
    return wx, wy, z_c

# Table center:
# In obs_0036 (cam at (1.73, 3.0), heading 180):
# Leg 1 (near left) is at (3.26, 1.09), Leg 2 (near right) is at (2.56, 1.09)
# Front-to-back legs: back legs are further in y (smaller y in world coords, or larger z in cam coords)
# In obs_0036, back legs bottom y:
# Let's find back legs:
img36 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0036.png')
# Far legs touch floor higher up in the image (smaller y)
# Far left leg: around x=200..220, y=400..415
back_leg_mask = (img36[:,:,2] > 80) & (img36[:,:,2] < 150) & (img36[:,:,0] < 50) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] > 390) & (np.arange(512)[:,None] < 420) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 180)
yb, xb = np.where(back_leg_mask)
print('Back leg bottom y:', yb.max(), 'x:', np.mean(xb))
wx_b, wy_b, _ = ray_ground(np.mean(xb), yb.max(), 1.73, 3.0, 180)
print(f'Back leg pos: ({wx_b:.2f}, {wy_b:.2f})')

# So table spans:
# x from ~2.5 to ~3.3 (center ~ 2.9)
# y from ~-0.5 to ~1.1 (center ~ 0.3)
print(f'Table center estimate: ({(2.56+3.26)/2:.2f}, {(1.09+wy_b)/2:.2f})')

# Credenza in obs_0028: cam at (0, 4.0), heading 60 deg
img28 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0028.png')
# Credenza doors are beige
cred_mask28 = (img28[:,:,0] > 120) & (img28[:,:,1] > 150) & (img28[:,:,2] > 180) & (np.arange(512)[None,:] > 350)
yc, xc = np.where(cred_mask28)
print('Credenza in obs_0028: bottom y =', yc.max(), 'center x =', np.mean(xc))
wx_cr, wy_cr, _ = ray_ground(np.mean(xc), yc.max(), 0, 4.0, 60)
print(f'Credenza from obs_0028: ({wx_cr:.2f}, {wy_cr:.2f})')
"
